data.description: Media depicting catalog records e.g. photo of an herbarium sheet, sketch of a parka, CT scan of a skull. Relationships to less-specific nodes (projects, localities) may be inferred from the specimen data and need not be explicitly recorded.
Media with an association to projects, but one which cannot be expressed more directly, e.g., through involved specimens.
Media best relating to a time and place.
Media which documents an accession (custody transfer documents) or all/most specimens in an accession (Accession Cards).
Most often JPG media derived from a DNG. Related term must be the valid URI of existing media.
Agent who is the subject of media. Related term must be an exact match for a unique agent name.
Media describing or documenting a cataloged item, but which do not depict the item itself, including field notes, scanned ledgers, oral histories, tag and label images, preparation catalogs, etc.
Media which documents a loan, such as long-winded email correspondence.

Typically refers to image retakes, where an image is rephotographed from the same view but at a different point in time. Often entails comparison of modern versus historic images to document landscape changes over time.
Media is a depiction of a place at a time.
Media which documents or describes a taxon name or concept.
Indicates the person who created the media (took a photograph, wrote field notes, etc.). The related term must be an exact match for a unique Agent Name.
